# ModelFormat

Namespace `Nfty.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Model`.

```csharp
public enum ModelFormat
```

The file shape a model is written in. All three are serialized from one glTF document and differ only in where the binary buffer lives.

## Values

- <span id="f-glb"></span>`Glb = 0` - One binary `.glb`: the JSON and the buffer in one self-contained file. The default — the form every viewer opens with nothing beside it.
- <span id="f-gltfwithbin"></span>`GltfWithBin = 1` - A text `.gltf` plus a sibling `.bin` holding the buffer; the JSON names the `.bin` by a relative URI.
- <span id="f-gltfembedded"></span>`GltfEmbedded = 2` - One text `.gltf` carrying its buffer inline as a base64 `data:` URI.
